description: The latest weekly local news for one saved territory, or all of them: health systems, practices, surgeons, payers and competitors, each item with its source, date and link, what it may mean for this rep, and the surgeons it touches (named in the article, or their practice is). Gathered weekly from the web and read against the rep's lines, customers and territory. Join an item's surgeons with surgeon_profile, opportunities or competitive_landscape to connect it to volume, engagement and company news.

territory.description: A saved territory's name or id; omit for all of them.
